title: Master of All Masters
author: Joseph Jacobs
summary: 女仆用主人发明的古怪名字，在夜里把主人叫醒。
publicDomainBasis: Published 1892; collected by Joseph Jacobs (1854–1916). Public domain in the United States and in China (author's life plus 70 years).

paragraphs.en: A girl once went to the fair to hire herself for servant. At last a funny-looking old gentleman engaged her, and took her home to his house. When she got there, he told her that he had something to teach her, for that in his house he had his own names for things.
paragraphs.zh: 从前，一个姑娘去集市上找活干，想给人当女仆。最后，一位模样古怪的老先生雇了她，把她带回自己家。到家后，他告诉她，他有东西要教她，因为在他家里，每样东西都有他自己的叫法。

paragraphs.en: He said to her: "What will you call me?"
paragraphs.zh: 他对她说：“你该怎么称呼我？”

paragraphs.en: "Master or mister, or whatever you please sir," says she.
paragraphs.zh: “老爷，或者先生，随您高兴，先生。”她说。

paragraphs.en: He said: "You must call me 'master of all masters.' And what would you call this?" pointing to his bed.
paragraphs.zh: 他说：“你必须叫我‘万主之主’。那这个你叫什么？”他指着自己的床。

paragraphs.en: "Bed or couch, or whatever you please, sir."
"No, that's my 'barnacle.' And what do you call these?" said he pointing to his pantaloons.
paragraphs.zh: “不对，那是我的‘藤壶’。那这些你叫什么？”他指着自己的裤子。

paragraphs.en: "Breeches or trousers, or whatever you please, sir."
paragraphs.zh: “马裤，或者长裤，随您高兴，先生。”

paragraphs.en: "You must call them 'squibs and crackers.' And what would you call her?" pointing to the cat.
paragraphs.zh: “你必须叫它们‘鞭炮和爆竹’。那她你叫什么？”他指着猫。

paragraphs.en: "Cat or kit, or whatever you please, sir."
"You must call her 'white-faced simminy.' And this now," showing the fire, "what would you call this?"
paragraphs.zh: “你必须叫她‘白脸小傻妮’。那这个，”他指着火，“你叫什么？”

paragraphs.en: "Fire or flame, or whatever you please, sir."
"You must call it 'hot cockalorum,' and what this?" he went on, pointing to the water.
paragraphs.zh: “你必须叫它‘热乎乎的大火球’。那这个呢？”他继续问，指着水。

paragraphs.en: "Water or wet, or whatever you please, sir."
paragraphs.zh: “水，或者湿东西，随您高兴，先生。”

paragraphs.en: "No, 'pondalorum' is its name. And what do you call all this?" asked he, as he pointed to the house.
paragraphs.zh: “不对，它叫‘水汪汪’。那这一切你叫什么？”他指着房子问。

paragraphs.en: "House or cottage, or whatever you please, sir."
paragraphs.zh: “房子，或者小屋，随您高兴，先生。”

paragraphs.en: That very night the servant woke her master up in a fright and said: "Master of all masters, get out of your barnacle and put on your squibs and crackers. For white-faced simminy has got a spark of hot cockalorum on its tail, and unless you get some pondalorum high topper mountain will be all on hot cockalorum.".... That's all.
paragraphs.zh: 就在那天夜里，女仆惊恐地把主人叫醒，说：“万主之主，快从您的‘藤壶’里出来，穿上您的‘鞭炮和爆竹’。因为‘白脸小傻妮’尾巴上沾了一点‘热乎乎的大火球’，您要是再不弄点‘水汪汪’来，‘高塔山’就要全烧成‘热乎乎的大火球’啦。”……故事到此结束。
